data.desc: Blink Charging Co. (Nasdaq: BLNK) is a global leader in electric vehicle (EV) charging equipment and services, enabling drivers, hosts, and fleets to easily transition to electric transportation through innovative charging solutions. Blink's principal line of products and services include Blink's EV charging network ('Blink Network'), EV charging equipment, EV charging services and energy management solution, EnergyConnect. The Blink Network uses proprietary, cloud-based software that operates, maintains, and tracks the EV charging stations connected to the network and the associated charging data. EnergyConnect is designed to help commercial customers and charging site operators monitor, manage, and optimize energy consumption associated with EV charging infrastructure.
